articles.summary: The recruitment landscape heading into 2026 isn't slowing down—it’s just getting noisier. We’re seeing more calls, more channels, and a mounting pressure to perform that feels heavier than ever before. But while the demands on recruiters have evolved, the tools they use are stuck in the past.
articles.title: Is Your Phone System Fit For Modern Recruitment?
